subjects.description: The pose, the outfit, the attitude — drawn head to toe so the whole personality comes through.

subjects.name: Full Body + Extras
subjects.tagline: With the things that make it yours
subjects.description: Everything in Full Body, plus the car, the pet, the house, the business or the hobby that tells people who this is.

exaggerations.name: Exaggerated
exaggerations.description: The classic caricature. We play up the features that make you, you — bigger head, bigger smile, bolder expression — for a funny piece that gets a laugh every time someone sees it.
exaggerations.alt: Exaggerated caricature of a man in glasses with an oversized head and wide grin

exaggerations.name: No Exaggeration
exaggerations.description: Drawn in our caricature line, but with your real proportions and nothing pushed for laughs. A flattering choice for a gift, a profile picture or the office wall.
exaggerations.alt: The same man drawn with natural, true-to-life proportions

styles.name: Expressive
styles.description: A fun and highly expressive caricature. The artist's line work stays clearly visible, with colour painted through the whole drawing. Stronger exaggeration, bigger character.
styles.bestFor: Best for a bold, fun piece with an obvious hand-drawn look.

images.alt: Expressive style caricature with visible line work and bright colour
Close-up of the expressive style showing the artist's line work

styles.name: Classic
styles.description: A more refined caricature. The line work is still visible, but the body and features are treated far more realistically — the character is there, the proportions and anatomy sit closer to life.
styles.bestFor: Best if you want the balance between caricature and realism.

images.alt: Classic style caricature with refined proportions and visible line work
Close-up of the classic style showing refined finish

styles.name: Realistic
styles.description: A fully painted caricature with a realistic finish. The original line work is no longer on show — this is a polished painted artwork that still keeps the exaggeration and character of the subject.
styles.bestFor: Best for a sophisticated, detailed painted piece you'd hang on a wall.

images.alt: Realistic style caricature, fully painted with no visible line work
Close-up of the realistic style showing the painted finish

howItWorks.title: 1. Build your order here
howItWorks.body: Your order starts filled in with our most popular choices. Change what you want drawn, the style or how many people, and the price updates as you go.

howItWorks.title: 2. Send it to us on WhatsApp
howItWorks.body: One tap sends your order across with everything already written out. We confirm the details, the timeline and the deposit.

howItWorks.title: 3. Send your photos, we start drawing
howItWorks.body: One clear photo of each person is all we need. You see the artwork and approve it before we finish and deliver.

assurances.title: How long does it take?
assurances.body: Most commissions are delivered in 3–5 working days once your photos and deposit are in. Need it sooner? Ask us about rush delivery on WhatsApp.

assurances.title: What photo should I send?
assurances.body: A clear, well-lit photo of each person's face, looking at the camera. A phone photo is perfectly fine — we'll tell you if we need a better one before starting.

assurances.title: Can I ask for changes?
assurances.body: Yes. You see the artwork before it's finished and one round of changes is included in every commission.

assurances.title: How do I pay?
assurances.body: A 50% deposit starts the work, with the balance due before the final file is delivered. We confirm everything on WhatsApp first.

priceTableNote: Prices are per person, in Nigerian Naira. Extras are quoted individually.

faqs.question: What is the difference between the three caricature styles?
faqs.answer: Expressive keeps the artist's line work clearly on show with strong exaggeration and a playful look. Classic still shows the line work but treats the body and features far more realistically. Realistic is fully painted with a polished finish and no visible line work, while keeping the character of a caricature.

faqs.question: How much does a caricature cost in Nigeria?
faqs.answer: At I Do Art Studios a commissioned caricature starts at ₦35,000 for an Expressive portrait and goes up to ₦115,000 for a fully realistic full-body piece with extras. The exact price depends on the style, whether it is a portrait or full body, and how many people are in the artwork.

faqs.question: Can you draw more than one person in the same artwork?
faqs.answer: Yes. Choose how many people you want and tell us whether they should appear together in one artwork or as separate pieces. For four people and above we price the artwork individually.

faqs.question: What are extras?
faqs.answer: Extras are the things that make the piece personal — a car, a pet, a house, tools of a trade, a hobby or props. They are drawn alongside the person and quoted individually, so we confirm the final price with you on WhatsApp before anything is paid.

faqs.question: Do I get a printed artwork or a digital file?
faqs.answer: Every commission is delivered as a high-resolution digital file. Prints and framing can be arranged with us on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: Do you draw live at events too?
faqs.answer: Yes. Live caricature entertainment for weddings, parties and corporate events is our other speciality — use the Book an Event button at the top of the page.
